title: One of the best gadgets I own
text:
One of the best gadgets I own. It's me, bf, and daughter. A full container is enough for 1 meal + a lunch worth of rice. It's always fluffy. I use the finger method as opposed to the instructions. I haven't overfilled it yet. If you don't know how much the rice will grow, definitely follow the instructions. But after a while, I think you could go for the finger method and get better use out of it. Good buy, love all the settings, so far it is holding up well after about 3 months of use.

**FOLLOW THE CARE AND MAINTENANCE INSTRUCTIONS**
